issues.text: In the nineteen sixties, a Japanese company needed a catchy name for a new pedometer. Manpo-kei. The ten thousand step meter. Why ten thousand?
issues.heard: in the 1960s a japanese company needed a catchy name for a new pedometer mahan po ke the 10000 step meter why 10000

text: Week one. Your calves hurt on the stairs. But you're sleeping like a baby. And you start wondering... why ten thousand? Who decided that? {playful} Here's the funny part. {dramatic} No doctor ever did. {playful} In the nineteen sixties, a Japanese company needed a catchy name for a new pedometer. Manpo-kei. The ten thousand step meter. Why ten thousand? One Harvard scientist thinks it's because the Japanese symbol for ten thousand... looks a bit like a little man walking. {deadpan} So the most famous health goal on Earth... started as an advert.
